[[File:Wookiee_thought_wave.png|thumb|right|200px|Mallatobuck sends a thought wave to Chewbacca.]]
A '''thought wave''' was a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] ability possessed by some [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[species]] from the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Thought waves allowed Wookiees to communicate mentally over great distances. Only adult Wookiees possessed the power, and thought waves could not be sent to younger Wookiees.<ref name="Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref>

Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'', which depicts [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] sending a thought wave, is set on [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] two-hundredth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]].</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Wookiee [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] sent her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] a thought wave while he was en route to Kashyyyk, warning him that their son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] was lost and in danger. When Chewbacca received the message, he jumped up from his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] seat in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and let out a roar, which startled his [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and friend, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. When the ''Millennium Falcon'' reached Kashyyyk's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Chewbacca piloted an [[explorer craft]] to the planet and rescued his son.<ref name="Wookiee Storybook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thought waves first appeared in ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'', a picture book written by [[Eleanor Ehrhardt]], illustrated by [[Patricia Wynne]], and published in [[1979]].<ref name="Wookiee Storybook" />
